verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes cubic exposing its own MCP server for external coding agents to consume (docs-8, probe-4, probe-rt-1) and even lets a connected agent manage cubic's subscription (docs-15) — this is cubic acting as an MCP *server*, not as a client that plugs in external MCP servers to gain their tools. There is no evidence cubic itself connects to or consumes third-party MCP servers to extend its own capabilities.
